blindSummary: This state/province carries one documented incident beyond the national pattern: in February 2025 a gender-nonconforming person who sold sex was murdered in a local town, dismembered and the remains dumped in the river in the region's largest city; the perpetrator was arrested within days and sentenced to 11 years in a strict-regime colony in September 2025 by the local city court. The case is recorded for the institutional response — swift arrest, prosecution and a substantial sentence — while press coverage mocked and misgendered the victim. The federal repression framework (anti-propaganda and extremism laws; for foreigners, detention of up to 15 days and deportation) otherwise applies unchanged in this state/province.
